newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK - DE BEERS LEADS TRADE.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIA STOCKS WEEK - DE BEERS LEADS TRADE.

text.p: the Namibian Stock Exchange last week with dual-listed De Beers
diamond company leading the trade with 155,000 shares to the
value of N$24.5 million, exchange officials said.
Car rental group Avis Holding dual listed on the bourse last
Tuesday and traded 350 shares at N$7.50 each.
A total of N$36.7 million shares were traded on the exchange
for a total volume of shares of 1,118,900.
The NSE Overall Index ended the week slightly up at 247.92
points compared to the previous week's close of 247.30.
The Local Index reached 165.61 points compared to a previous
Demand for Namibia Breweries shares pushed the
share price to N$3.10. First National Bank of Namibia closed at
N$4.00 per share from starting the week at N$4.10. African
